name: voice
description: Speak with your agent and hear it talk back — speech-to-text and text-to-speech on your own box, or on OpenRouter if you choose.

verbs.name: voice
verbs.summary: talk to your agent by voice; pick where hearing and speaking run

setup.hint: voice needs a host-level engine that 5dive will not install behind your back: ffmpeg, faster-whisper and edge-tts, plus a warm transcription service on port 8765. The plugin ships the installer, so this runs off the copy `plugin add` already put on your box. It stays on this box by default; `sudo 5dive voice backend openrouter` moves hearing and speaking to OpenRouter.

fields.label: Where hearing and speaking run
fields.help: On this server, your voice notes never leave it; replies are still spoken by Microsoft's online voices. OpenRouter is more accurate and sends both the audio and the reply text to OpenRouter, which needs an OpenRouter key on this server.

fields.label: Where hearing runs
fields.help: Hearing alone. On this server, your voice notes never leave it. Unset, hearing follows the setting above.

fields.label: Hearing model (this server)
fields.help: Used only when hearing runs on this server. Fast hears a note about 2-3 times quicker and is the default. Most accurate hears mixed-language and unclear speech better, and needs about 3 GB of memory.

fields.label: Language of your voice notes (this server)
fields.help: Used only when hearing runs on this server. auto detects the language of every note. A two-letter code such as ru or en skips that step: faster, and never mistakes a short note for another language.

fields.label: Hearing speed (this server)
fields.help: Used only when hearing runs on this server. Fast checks one reading of each note instead of five: about a third quicker, and slightly less accurate on unclear speech.

fields.label: Hearing model (OpenRouter)
fields.help: Used only on OpenRouter. The default understands 99+ languages. meta/muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 is more accurate in English but not validated for Russian or Ukrainian.

fields.label: Speaking voice (OpenRouter)
fields.help: Used only on OpenRouter. A voice name the speaking model offers.
